findings.summary: A bounded retained response with an extreme JSON exponent escapes the constant-diagnostic hold path.
findings.reproduction: Use the valid six-read invented reply/editor fixture. Add ignored_numeric_metadata:1e999999999999999999999999 to the outer wrapper of observations[0].result_json. The negative exponent 1e-999999999999999999999999 reproduces the same failure. Keep original frontier and receipt bytes and bindings. Run companion probes against the exact reviewed source.
findings.expected: snapshot_report returns a bounded hold JSON report with constant diagnostics and no fetched-text echo.
findings.actual: json.loads(parse_float=Decimal) raises decimal.InvalidOperation for these valid JSON numeric tokens. The snapshot_report catch list omits that exception. Actual CLI exits 1 with empty stdout and decimal.InvalidOperation traceback, producing no hold report. Inputs and file set remain unchanged.
